name: Dr. Sarah Bennett
bio: Dr. Bennett provides ongoing family care for patients of all ages, with a focus on preventive care and chronic disease management.

name: Dr. Michael Tran
bio: Dr. Tran sees rostered patients and supports the walk-in clinic, with a particular interest in mental health and men's health.

name: Aisha Malik
bio: Aisha leads the pharmacy team, with a focus on medication reviews and compliance packaging for long-term care patients.
